div.div: Notes the metadata does not advertise uq_ indexes are not flagged unique in live metadata except uq_job_listings_source_job; the packed dedupe tuples are enforced by the write path (insert-if-absent), not by MongoDB. applications._id is the assigned String source:sourceJobId, so its uniqueness rides on the default _id_ index. Only three write paths use a transaction; single-document writes stay outside on purpose. job_state is a ledger: it records attempts and outcomes and never schedules work.
